observations.text: Flow 3: thoughts act back on the thinker.
observations.meaning: Flow 3: thoughts act back on the thinker. They answer back ("my thoughts answer me, because of my haste within me"), alarm, weary and multiply. The responses differ: keep them in the heart (Daniel), meet them with God's consolation, take them into the sanctuary

observations.text: Flow 5: what is devised comes back.
observations.meaning: Flow 5: what is devised comes back. The plan returns on the deviser's head (Est 9:25); the schemer is caught in his own scheme (Psa 10:2); disaster is "the fruit of their devices" (Jer 6:19). God answers "devise wickedness" with "I am devising disaster" (Mic 2:1, 3). It also comes back for good: "The plans of the diligent lead surely to abundance" (Pro 21:5); "Commit your work to the Lord, and your plans will be established" (16:3)
